title: QuickComposter
description: A lightweight plugin for Paper/Folia that allows players to quickly fill composters by right-clicking with compostable items. (or any item, can be configured)
body:
# QuickComposter

A lightweight Minecraft plugin for Paper/Folia that allows players to quickly fill composters by right-clicking with compostable items. (or any item, can be configured)

Please be sure to spam message me on discord if this breaks.
